# Bundled React runtime for the authoring editor

The authoring editor (js/src, entry js/src/mount.tsx) is written in
TypeScript/React and compiled from source by the development-only esbuild
toolchain (build.mjs / `make react`) into the AMD module
`amd/build/editor_lazy.min.js`. That bundle contains React, ReactDOM and
Scheduler; see ../../../thirdpartylibs.xml for the authoritative third-party
declaration and licences.

Why this directory exists: Moodle's Grunt pipeline (and moodle-plugin-ci)
`stat()` every `<location>` declared in thirdpartylibs.xml. Pointing the
declaration at this always-present source-side directory — rather than at the
`amd/build/editor_lazy.min.js` build artefact — keeps the JS lint job green even
when the prebuilt bundle is not present in a checkout (for example when a
repository ignores `amd/build/`, since that bundle has no `amd/src` counterpart
and is not regenerated by `grunt amd`). The bundle is still loaded at runtime
as the AMD module `mod_elang/editor_lazy`; when it is absent the editor
bootstrap fails gracefully instead of breaking the whole build.

React and ReactDOM are distributed under the MIT licence
(https://react.dev, https://github.com/facebook/react).
